contract: FRONTEND.md: merchant scanner workflow, existing dark theme and FastAPI API, accessible scanner/history/guide views, 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x900 layouts.

accessibility.evidence: Native labeled controls and fieldsets; keyboard Tab moved from Browse files to Take a photo with a solid visible outline. Main action buttons measured at least 44px high. 81 visible desktop text nodes met the applicable 4.5:1 or 3:1 contrast threshold. Activating the reduced-motion CSS rule removed animation. Status and error messages have live regions. This is a targeted check, not a full assistive-technology certification.

responsive.evidence: 36 browser assertions passed at each target viewport (108 checks total), including no horizontal overflow before upload or with a long filename and transaction ID. Desktop uses a fixed sidebar and two columns; tablet uses top navigation; phone stacks upload and report. Screenshots visually inspected.

empty.evidence: No file: disabled analysis button, upload prompt and report placeholder. New scan restores the same state.

loading.evidence: Delayed fixture reveals progress and locks file/app controls. A dropped replacement is ignored during the request. Cancel restores controls with an explicit server-may-still-save warning.

error.evidence: Unsupported, empty, oversized and damaged images rejected. Server errors, malformed results, offline service, unavailable history and retry controls exercised.

partial.evidence: Missing reference fixture renders a partial notice and 8/9 completed checks. Missing checks object renders all nine unavailable, never as passes. OCR markup is inert text.

success.evidence: Suspicious, manual and no-obvious-anomaly results rendered; report export and filtered history CSV export initiated. Clear verdict retains the not-proof-of-payment explanation.

permission.reason: There is no application-managed permission prompt. The camera uses a native file input with capture=environment; the browser/OS owns permission and dismissal. Browse files remains a fallback. Physical camera capture and OS permission dialogs were not tested.

renderedEvidence.observation: Single-column scanner and report, compact three-item navigation, readable app options and no page overflow. QA fixture counts/history, not real transactions.
Top navigation and two-column scanner; upload controls, report placeholder and recent history fit. The visible toast is from the export test.
Fixed sidebar, workspace statistics, side-by-side upload and analysis, primary scan control within the first viewport. Full-page capture includes history below the fold.

limitations: Browser requests were supplied with deterministic API fixtures matching the supplied backend schema; no live browser-to-backend run was verified.
The existing Python regression suite stalled at its first TestClient request in this environment and was interrupted; no backend-test pass is claimed.
Camera hardware, native camera permission prompts and screen-reader operation require real-device testing.
